Frequently Asked Questions About Belcrest’s Montana Raised Beef

How often will we restock Belcrest Beef?

We plan on restocking beef every 4-8 weeks. We have processing dates already scheduled every other month in 2022. YAY!  

 

How long do we Dry-Age our beef?

ALL of our beef is dry-aged for at least 21 days. You will taste the difference, 

we promise!

 

What do we feed our cattle? Are they Grass-Fed?

Our cattle are raised in Montana and on grass pasture their entire lives. We are considered Grass-Fed & Barley-Finished. Our operation does not have a feed lot. We offer "Grain-Finish" beef which means we add Steam Rolled Barley into their diet for 6 months before processing. That is it! 

 

Do we have an order minimum?

No, you can order as much or as little as you would like. We do recommend a minimum of 5 lbs in order to keep the beef frozen in transit. All orders are shipped with 5 lbs of dry ice.

 

Why is shipping so expensive? 

Shipping 1-2 day air is just plain costly. With material costs and shipping costs we do our best to keep our prices consistent. We have created our flat rate shipping prices based on 4 different zones in the U.S.

Montana- $19

Central US-$29

West Coast-$39

East Coast-$49

The prices you see are the same if you by 5lbs of ground beef or create a 15lb box of beef, so the more you order the better the shipping cost.

About Belcrest Farms

Hey Y’all, we are the Howland Family. Jeff and Michelle grew up in sunny Southern California and moved our family to the mountains of beautiful Bozeman, Montana in 2019. Jeff worked in the food service industry for over 10 years. Michelle worked as a Vet Tech part time and stayed home with our 2 amazing boys, Grayson (9) and Hudson (7). We desired a change but didn’t know what that looked like for our family until Michelle had the crazy & wonderful idea of leaving our busy life in suburban California for the slower pace of ranch life in Montana.  Michelle grew up dreaming of living in the Treasure State.  She rode horseback in the Big Sky mountains as a child and loved every minute of it. Jeff had a love for great food from an early age and dreamed of being a chef.

Our lives in California revolved around things we loved: Family, FOOD & Animals but something was missing. Our time together as a family was not high in quantity or quality and something had to change. Insert Montana! A real dream come true! With Jeff’s aspiration of entrepreneurship and Michelle’s love for animals, Belcrest Farms was born! 

This is a family business and we love working together on a daily basis. Michelle’s Mom Kristy moved to Bozeman with the family too. Having her here with us has made the transition much easier and she helps around the farm daily. 

Thanks Momo!

Feeding people and being a part of the Ag community is such a blessing. We love hearing that people enjoy the product we put so much love, time and effort into. 

Give our premium beef a try. You won’t regret it!

Food for thought.

Knowing where your food comes from gives you peace of mind. You can nourish yourself and your family while supporting someone else’s family. Whether you buy from us or another ranch, going direct to the source is always the best way.
